result.finding: Minimal security implementation. The application has no authentication, authorization, HTTPS/TLS, or encryption. Database credentials are hardcoded in plain text. Spring Security is not included as a dependency. The application is suitable for development/demo purposes only and requires significant security hardening before production use.
evidence: pom.xml: spring-boot-starter-security is NOT included as a dependency
application.yaml: No server.ssl configuration — HTTP only on port 8080
No JWT, OAuth2, or API key authentication patterns found in source code
No @PreAuthorize, @Secured, or role-based access control annotations found
No encryption or key management usage in source code
No CORS, HSTS, or security header configuration found
values: Security risk: Hardcoded database credentials in application.yaml (plain text)
